map.产品概念评估与定价测试: Product concept evaluation and pricing test
map.在research场景里，先统一 Assessor 50 的输入口径，再输出可复: In a research setting, first unify the input definitions for Assessor 50, then output a reusable structure for fast reconciliation and review.
map.在业务流程中，先做小样本试算再扩展规模，能快速验证参数假设是否与实际口径一致。: In a business process, running a small sample calculation before scaling up quickly verifies whether the parameter assumptions match the actual definitions.
map.如何减少误用导致的偏差？: How do I reduce the bias caused by misuse?
map.建议固定输入单位、统一日期范围，并与对照样本比对；如出现明显偏移，优先核查原始数: Fix the input units, unify the date range and compare against a control sample; if a clear shift appears, check the raw data cleaning rules first.
map.当同类任务需要批量处理时，可用该工具做第一轮标准化；结果异常时再回到人工复核环节: When similar tasks must be processed in bulk, the tool can do the first round of standardisation; when results look abnormal, go back to manual review to lower the miss rate.
map.输入广告投放数据（曝光效果/记忆效果/态度效果），系统计算广告效果指数（AEI）: Enter advertising placement data (exposure effect, memory effect, attitude effect) and the system computes an advertising effectiveness index (AEI), giving an effect grade and optimisation advice.
map.这个 research 工具适合什么阶段使用？: What stage is this research tool suited to?
map.适合需求澄清和第一轮评估阶段；输出可直接用于方案讨论、初筛与结果复核，但关键决策: It suits the requirements clarification and first-round evaluation stage; the output can be used directly for plan discussion, screening and result review, but key decisions should be reconfirmed against historical strategy.
map.：先准备一组典型样本并固定单位与格式，运行一次并记录输出；再切换到边界样本（含缺: : first prepare a set of typical samples with fixed units and formats, run it once and record the output; then switch to boundary samples (with missing items and outliers) to see whether the results are explainable, so a reviewable analysis checklist can be formed.
